Searched map for 51.52461, -0.63830 and opened a visible Ping cluster. The first selected out-of-service event showed Ping Time N/A; selected a second event dated 06/10/2026 10:32:56 and observed Ping Time 0 ms.

After all independent criteria, repeated a clean confirmation from the launcher with a newly added Ping layer, selected the visible cluster near Slough and opened event 06/10/2026 10:36:20. Compared its cluster-row 28 ms value with the selected detail view's Ping Time 28 ms.

reason: The selected event's detail displays Ping Time 28 ms, matching its 28 ms cluster row and event time 06/10/2026 10:36:20. Earlier independent selections within this criterion also showed 0 ms for a recorded timeout and N/A for an unavailable measurement. Confirmation-final is the decisive assertion; exploratory captures are setup.

Opened GIS and a fresh Surveyor configuration, selected Ping, and deselected 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G SA, Wi-Fi and Out of Service, leaving only 5G NSA selected.

Opened event 06/10/2026 10:36:20 and verified matching Ping Time 28 ms, Jitter 3 ms, Data Technology 5G NSA, Cell ID 72374_135_4 and Error Message No error.

criterion: When Ping details fail to load, the detail view shows an error state and does not display data as if it belonged to the selected point.
steps_taken: Navigated to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher and captured this criterion's initial state.
Opened GIS, opened Surveyor, selected Active layer Ping and added the layer with Last 30 days and no account, route, team or network restrictions.
Selected the visible timeout cluster and opened event 06/10/2026 10:32:56.
Verified that event details loaded, showing its matching time, Ping Time 0 ms, Jitter 0 ms and recorded NETWORK_TIMEOUT measurement attribute.
Inspected network results: GET /api/platform/surveyor/ping/points and POST /api/platform/surveyor/ping/cluster-details, /event-l3/event, /event-l3/survey and /event-analysis all returned HTTP 200.
Recorded decisive final URL, closed event/cluster, removed the layer and returned to the launcher after all checks.
reason: NETWORK_TIMEOUT is a historical Ping measurement result, not a failed detail-service request. The available event details loaded successfully.
